jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

Summary

This position performs skilled, technical work installing, operating, maintaining, and repairing electrical, instrumentation, control, and communication systems used in City of Wichita wastewater treatment plants, lift stations, force mains, and reuse facilities. Employees troubleshoot complex electrical and control issues, service PLC and SCADA components, calibrate meters and instruments, and support safe, reliable operation of critical wastewater infrastructure. Work varies by assignment and competency level, with opportunities to advance through four progression levels as additional skills and training are achieved. Duties are performed under the direction of a supervisor and may involve working near high-voltage equipment, in confined spaces, outdoors, and at varying facility locations.
Work location may vary between treatment plants

Workdays and Hours - Monday - Friday 7:00am - 3:30pm

Bargaining Unit: Service Employee's International (SEIU)

Employees within the department or division shall be given first consideration

Posting may close at any time

Examples of duties
• Installs, maintains, repairs, and adjusts electric motors, switches, wiring, fuses, and transformers.

• Foundational understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), including database structures and relationships.

We are seeking highly experienced PhD Physicists and senior research professionals to contribute their scientific expertise to the development, evaluation, and advancement of next-generation Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

In this role, you will work alongside leading AI researchers to assess how advanced AI models understand and reason about complex physics concepts and real-world scientific problems. Position: Instrument Mechanic Lead - Small Arms/Optics

AFO is looking for an Instrument Mechanic Lead to work in Fort Sill, OK. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

The Instrument Mechanic Lead installs, repairs, maintains, and adjusts indicating, recording, telemetering, and controlling instruments used to measure and control variables, such as pressure, flow, temperature, motion, force, and chemical composition, using hand tools and precision instruments. This worker disassembles malfunctioning instruments, examines and tests mechanism and circuitry for defects; troubleshoots equipment in or out of control system and replaces or repairs defective parts, reassembles instrument and tests assembly for conformance with specifications, using instruments, such as potentiometer, resistance bridge, manometer, and pressure gauge;

jobs.title: Quantum Computer Deployment Physicist 74012
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Quantum Computer Deployment Physicist based out of one of our US Quantinuum offices or remotely where business requirements allow to install and service Helios systems worldwide.

Helios is our current-generation quantum computer with 98 physical qubits and >99.
9% two-qubit fidelities that is available through the cloud.
Installation of on-premises units are already planned for Singapore and Oracle.

This role offers the opportunity to work remotely from an approved location.
The successful candidate may be based at any US Quantinuum office orwork remotely where business requirements allow, while traveling extensively to Quantinuum facilities and customer locations worldwide in support of quantum system deployments.
To develop deep familiarity with Helios hardware and software, the candidate will participate in system integration, validation, commissioning, and shipment-readiness activities across Quantinuum sites, both in person and remotely as required.

As a key member of the deployment organization, they will then focus on critical installation, commissioning, validation, and acceptance activities at customer facilities, serving as a technical authority for quantum system performance during deployment.
Working alongside experts in atomic physics, hardware, software, controls, lasers, cryogenics, and systems engineering, they will help deliver some of the world's most advanced quantum computers into operational customer environments.

Beyond Helios, the candidate will play an important role in shaping Quantinuum's future on-premises quantum computing offerings by contributing deployment experience, field feedback, and technical expertise to the design, execution, serviceability, and scalability of next-generation systems.

This role includes extensive international travel supporting major customer deployments and business-critical installations worldwide.
Deployment assignments may involve extended on-site presence, typically ranging from several weeks to multiple months, with remote or office-based work between deployments.
Outside active deployment windows, travel is expected to be approximately 25%, depending on program needs, training, customer support, and future installation planning.

All applicants for placement in safety-sensitive positions will be required to submit to a pre-employment drug test.

Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare Helios systems for shipment, relocation, installation, bring-up, validation, and customer acceptance.

• Serve as the deployment team's subject matter expert for atomic physics, trapped-ion operations, and qubit performance, providing technical leadership during critical integration and validation activities.

• Own deployment success criteria related to quantum system performance, validation, verification, and customer acceptance testing.

• Diagnose and resolve complex issues spanning quantum hardware, controls, software, optics, vacuum systems, electronics, and supporting infrastructure.

• Lead technical decision-making during high-pressure integration and validation windows at Quantinuum and customer sites.

• Participate in integration and validation of Helios systems at Quantinuum prior to deployment.

• Provide remote support and on-site service for deployed Helios systems with the support of subject matter experts and a global technical team.

• Train internal team members and, where appropriate, customer-side personnel on deployment processes, validation workflows, operational readiness, and best practices.

• Improve and mature deployment plans, standard work, work instructions, test plans, troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and validation processes.

• Partner with internal engineering, product, operations, and service teams to translate field lessons learned into future product and deployment improvements.

• Contribute to future on-premises hardware offerings beyond Helios, including design-for-deployment, execution planning, commissioning
